approval_owner: Codex under the user's project-lead delegation
intent: Start a bounded, local, non-commercial exploration promptly on a newly acquired documented research-data source; do not relabel historical Yahoo files as licensed
asset_selection_reason: Both USD spot pairs have complete declared daily coverage and were specified before forecast-score access; GSPC/N225 are absent because of unresolved source-use basis, not poor scores
source: CryptoDataDownload Bitstamp daily OHLC; new data version

data_contract.units: USD per base crypto unit; exchange spot OHLC, no equity adjustment
data_contract.grid: 24/7 daily candles, Unix timestamp interpreted as UTC candle start; verified midnight and date-label agreement
data_contract.target: Close of the next candle after 96 preceding completed daily OHLC candles
data_contract.split_on: target candle start timestamp, half-open intervals
data_contract.first_training_target: 2018-04-07; context must be fully within the declared train interval
data_contract.data_qualification_exposure: QA custodian inspected prices before 2026; fit workers receive train/validation packages only. Test is exploratory and historically exposed across the broader project. No unexposed-confirmation claim.
data_contract.missing_or_invalid_rule: Any missing daily key, non-finite/non-positive OHLC or inconsistent OHLC range causes failure; no filling, silent deletion, offset or score-driven asset substitution

line_A.estimand: Descriptive paired loss change with fewer training targets within a fixed asset and forecast task
line_A.retention: Contiguous tail of ceil(fraction * full eligible train-target count), ending at the same cutoff; preserve 96 preceding context candles. Report target count and actual raw-context span separately.
line_A.invariants: Same validation/test keys, model configuration, seeds and maximum optimizer steps; full-training-prefix naive-loss denominator remains fixed across fractions for comparable RMSSE

line_B.estimand: Descriptive difficulty ranking and roster composition under per-asset models; no causal asset-count training claim
line_B.ranking: Mean validation RMSSE(F) over all three seeds; ties broken by lexicographic asset ID
line_B.reuse: Reuse the 100%-history fits from line A; different questions with shared evidence, not independent statistical samples
line_B.summary: Equal-asset mean and median of per-asset seed-mean RMSSE; always retain complete per-asset results

model.reference: Existing R1 model_bundle_v3 full DeReFusion implementation; exact source pins, no architecture changes
model.fidelity: All listed architecture settings match the earlier candidate matrix and pinned model configuration: d_ff/d_model=4, d_model/n_heads=8; single-layer LSTM fixed in source. Record actual parameter count before fitting. This is the full model, not a claim about the nonlinear branch alone.
model.preprocessing: For each asset/fraction, channelwise population mean/std from that fraction's training contexts and targets only; apply unchanged to validation/test; retain model RevIN
model.loss: Mean squared next-Close error in training-normalized units
model.checkpoint_rule: Lowest complete validation-key MSE; strict improvement only, ties retain earlier step; no early stopping; record sample exposures and epochs
model.schedule_change: This new exploratory protocol uses a fixed 600-step budget instead of the prior R1 epoch/patience schedule, to compare history sizes under equal step caps. It is not an R1 run.

linear_baseline.identity: Ridge linear regression on flattened 96x4 training-standardized OHLC windows with intercept; no DLinear label
linear_baseline.objective: mean squared error plus lambda * squared coefficient norm; intercept unpenalized
linear_baseline.selection: Complete validation-key MSE, strict improvement; ties retain earliest ascending lambda
linear_baseline.seeds: Deterministic; seed repeats are not independent baseline evidence

persistence: Predict last observed Close in each 96-candle context

losses: RMSSE = sqrt(MSE / full-train mean squared one-day Close difference)
metrics.report: Per asset/fraction/seed, full test and 2024/2025 separately, shared key hashes/counts, F/L/P losses and MSE(L)-MSE(F)
metrics.rmsse_denominator: One-day Close differences entirely within the full [2018,2023) training prefix; never fitted/selected with test; fixed metric ruler across fractions
metrics.coverage: 100% of expected daily prediction keys, including incomplete batches
metrics.claims: Exploratory descriptions only; no market-level significance, no pooled raw MSE, no seed independence or nonlinear-mechanism claim; 600 steps may undertrain and are not a convergence guarantee

access: Custodian prepares roles; training subprocess accepts only train and validation package paths; independent evaluator gets test only after all fitting and the ranking freeze; T0 process/input discipline, not OS isolation
failure_policy: No automatic retry or configuration change; retain failure record and halt affected batch. Repairs require a new attempt/release. No silent removal of seed, asset or fraction.
publication: Local internal research artifacts only for this release; no public raw CSV, predictions, checkpoints or model weights; publishing summaries requires separate review
